summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new Asset and Loan modules with Rental yield integration. Fixed backend bug: IncomeSource model missing assetId and securityDeposit fields. All 25 backend tests pass (100%). All 15 frontend UI tests pass (100%). Full CRUD operations, EMI calculation, Appreciation %, loan linking, and rental yield calculation working correctly.

issues: Rental Yield % not displayed on rental cards - only shows in form when editing. Requirements mention 'Rental Yield on cards + dashboard' - consider adding yield display to card

action_items: Consider adding Rental Yield % display on My Rental list cards (currently only shows in form)
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: IncomeSource response model was missing assetId and securityDeposit fields - added in server.py line 65-67
EMI calculation working correctly: ₹43,391.16 for 50L principal at 8.5% for 240 months
Rental Yield calculation correct: 4.00% for ₹25,000/month on ₹75L asset value
Appreciation % calculation correct: +50.0% for ₹75L current vs ₹50L purchase value
Net Worth calculation correct: ₹25L (Asset: ₹75L - Loan Outstanding: ₹50L)
All 6 asset types available: Residential Property, Commercial Property, Land, Vehicle, Equipment, Other
Is Financed toggle correctly shows/hides loan dropdown
Asset-Loan linking working - asset shows linked loan's outstanding amount
seed_data_creation: Test data created with UI_TEST_ prefix and automatically cleaned up after testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: New modules added: Assets (/api/assets) with 6 types, Loans (/api/loans) with EMI calculation. Rental Income updated with assetId and securityDeposit fields. Rental Yield = (Annual Rent / Asset Value) * 100. EMI = P*r*(1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1). Routes: /my-loans (list), /loan (create), /loan/:id (edit), /my-assets (list), /asset (create), /asset/:id (edit). Backend bug fixed: added assetId and securityDeposit to IncomeSource model.
